annotations.title: Fuel prices and crude oil (maximum prices, Brent, WTI)

description: Use for the maximum fuel prices that the state sets and for crude oil prices (Brent, WTI) in USD and PLN. For average prices in shops, use get_retail_prices. topic max: maximum retail prices of Pb95, Pb98 and diesel in PLN per litre announced by the Minister of Energy in Monitor Polski: price in force, next day price if announced, and recent history. topic oil: Brent and WTI crude oil spot prices (U.S. Energy Information Administration) in USD and PLN per barrel at the NBP mid rate of the trading day, week, month and year change, 52-week range, Ropa Brent w złotych finwire (finwire_brent_pln), and recent weeks of Polish pump prices (European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin) next to the crude cost per litre. Default all.

history.description: Number of past maximum price announcements, default 7.
